name: Multi-project prioritization and next-action selection
purpose: Compare real candidate work across multiple owner projects, preserve tradeoffs and uncertainty, and select one useful next action whose target and budget remain bound after authorization.

preconditions.statement: Each project and candidate has a stable identity, goal link, evidence link, and current lifecycle state.
Scoring inputs include value, urgency, risk, information gain, cost, reversibility, and opportunity cost.
Owner constraints and STOP/veto state are evaluated before any target is selected.

success_criteria.statement: The decision records every eligible alternative, score input, uncertainty, dependency, and opportunity cost.
The selected beta repair is explainably higher value under the frozen inputs and remains bound to its canonical target.
Restart or duplicate selection produces one durable next-action decision and never two executing missions.
Invalidated evidence restores the prior portfolio state and records a superseding decision instead of rewriting history.

unacceptable_outcomes.statement: The selected performer substitutes a different project, repository, recipient, or target after authorization.
Scoring hides an eligible alternative, uncertainty, budget overflow, or opportunity cost.
No valuable action exists but the system invents busy work instead of reporting honest waiting.

intervention_rules.trigger: No eligible action has positive evidence-backed value within constraints
intervention_rules.response: Emit a durable honest waiting decision and schedule the next evidence event

intervention_rules.trigger: A required external fact for all high-value candidates is unavailable
intervention_rules.response: Record the shared dependency and continue any independent safe work

intervention_rules.trigger: Selected target identity differs at execution time
intervention_rules.response: Refuse the action and require a new evidence-backed decision

failure_injections.inject: Swap the selected target from project beta to project alpha after authorization
failure_injections.expected_response: Canonical target validation refuses execution and emits a target mismatch

failure_injections.inject: Replay the same portfolio-selection event after restart
failure_injections.expected_response: The idempotency key resolves to the existing decision and mission

failure_injections.inject: Increase the selected action's effect budget beyond the frozen maximum
failure_injections.expected_response: Budget enforcement refuses the action before any effect

requirements: Reload portfolio inputs and the accepted decision from their content hashes
Reconcile any mission dispatch against the single decision idempotency key
Re-score only when an input version actually changes
Return the selected candidate to its exact pre-dispatch state when authorization fails
Append a superseding decision that references the rejected decision and evidence
rollback.restoration_target: pre-selection portfolio state and nonexecuting candidate lifecycle
